subject.title: fix(sessions): keep Matrix DM session keys case-distinct per peer

question: Should this PR land now as a partial mitigation while the linked issue remains open for `per-peer`, or must Matrix `per-peer` isolation be solved before this work is accepted?
rationale: Preserving case in channel-agnostic persisted keys may alter cross-channel identity and upgrade semantics, while leaving the scope folded retains a documented transcript-isolation gap; that tradeoff requires explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Land partial mitigation
options.body: Remove the closing reference, merge the proven channel-scoped fix, and keep the canonical issue open for a separately designed `per-peer` migration.

options.title: Complete all DM scopes
options.body: Hold this PR until a migration-safe key shape and alias policy also isolate case-distinct Matrix users under `per-peer`.

options.title: Reject per-peer support
options.body: Explicitly declare `per-peer` unsupported for opaque case-sensitive identities and revise security guidance so operators cannot mistake it for peer isolation on Matrix.

recommendation.title: Land partial mitigation
recommendation.body: Remove the closing reference, merge the proven channel-scoped fix, and keep the canonical issue open for a separately designed `per-peer` migration.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the preceding compatibility-sensitive Matrix session-key design and are best positioned to decide whether its channel-agnostic limitation is acceptable.
